name: Higashi-Koenji
tagline: Shinjuku in 10 minutes and Shibuya in 19 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Suginami City, served by Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 29 minutes to Otemachi, 10 minutes to Shinjuku, 19 minutes to Shibuya and 41 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 39.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 9.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 39.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 33 m to 42.2 m, a difference of 9.2 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 3 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 10 clinics and 7 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 救世軍ブース記念病院, about 842 m away and 杏林大学医学部付属杉並病院, about 890 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

rentRange.note: One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000, 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000 and 2LDK ¥230,000 to ¥240,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
